There is no hard limit on the number of markers. I would think that 8 Gb RAM would be sufficient.

Exactly what functions are you using that are behaving slowly?

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How many markers can be handled by R/QTL?
parts:
You'll run into trouble with est.rf(), as it's calculating ~50 million pairwise linkage tests.
And you won't have enough pixels on your screen to view the results.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How many markers can be handled by R/QTL?
parts:
You can't run formLinkageGroups without the result of est.rf.

You could try running est.rf and formLinkageGroups on multiple subsets of markers and then combine the results in some way.

karl
